svg.title: PRX wordmark
svg.desc: prx set in the PRX stroke letterforms (2.5 stroke, x-height 10), with the x drawn as the Verdict X: a check crossed by an interrupted counter-stroke, fitted to the x-height with a small optical overshoot and an even gap on both sides of the crossing. Strokes use currentColor (default #18181B), so inline use can recolor it for dark backgrounds.
